title: gate add does not class a design question as secrets for the word token, or as an agents rule for the word skill, when it names a count or a doc
goal: gate add's class words match a secret or credential (an access token, a key) and not a token count such as wasted_tokens, and an agents-rule question by the rule it changes and not the word skill alone, so a metric or doc-placement choice stays a provisional design gate (SP-p46hofrg close: ST-kx6qdtkv g4 on wasted_tokens was classed secrets and blocking; ST-6cabusn2 g1 on which article holds -p facts was classed blocking for the word skill)
notes: check to tighten at planning: the command given only proves the tool runs Seen on ST-6n5xrkbt g2 (2026-10-26): a gate question about how a task's text shares a token budget between pack questions was classed secrets (matched 'token'); the question is about a count of tokens, no credential. Seen again 2026-10-27 on ST-jvthzus2: gate add classed a question about how tokens and USD per right answer are shown in a benchmark report as secrets (matched 'token') and made it blocking, though it names no credential.
